title: OpenStax's statement of natural selection
summary: The textbook says offspring vary, variation is inherited, and some inherited traits leave more descendants.
body: OpenStax Biology 2e, section 18.1, says evolution by natural selection describes a mechanism for how species change over time, that the idea was discussed before Darwin, and that Darwin and Wallace reasoned from heritable variation: offspring with inherited characteristics that help them compete leave more offspring. The v1 four-step list (variation, inheritance, selection, time) is a classroom compression of that argument. It is a textbook summary, evidence strength moderate as a secondary source, not a new observation.
